spans.title: The Chain of Thought
spans.blurb: On a night walk through Paris, a man answers his companion's silent thoughts aloud, then retraces every link of the invisible chain that led him there.

spans.title: The Sealed Abbey
spans.blurb: A plague empties the countryside, its whole course half an hour. A prince gathers a thousand friends behind welded iron gates and provides every pleasure.

spans.title: The Cask of Amontillado
spans.blurb: During carnival's madness, a man nursing a secret grudge dangles a rare wine before a connoisseur in motley and leads him down into the family catacombs.

spans.title: Hector and Andromache
spans.blurb: A warrior in full armour reaches for his baby son, who shrieks at the nodding plume of his helmet. Laughter, a prayer, and a farewell follow.

spans.title: But Why Turkish?
spans.blurb: A detective glances at his friend's boots and asks an impossible question. Pressed to explain his method, he starts instead with mud splashes on a coat sleeve.

spans.title: The Clock and the Cap
spans.blurb: A boy working at a furnace nudges the clock hands forward each morning to make it to school, then faces a second problem: every other child wears a hat.

spans.title: Fifty Cents and a Broom
spans.blurb: Penniless in a strange city, a young traveler sleeps under a board sidewalk and unloads pig iron, still set on reaching the school of his dreams.

spans.title: Who Put Salt in the Water?
spans.blurb: A child springs into the surf without fear until a wave pulls the ground away. Rescued and furious, she has one burning question about the sea.

spans.title: Everything Has a Name
spans.blurb: A wordless child meets the stranger who spells letters into her hand. The finger game means nothing to her until one morning beside the water spout.

spans.title: Letting Her Go
spans.blurb: A corporal marches a beautiful prisoner to jail through winding streets. She drops her mantilla, guesses his home country, and begins to speak his language.

spans.title: A Bedfellow with a Tomahawk
spans.blurb: In a dark inn room, a traveler's unknown bedfellow climbs in with a tomahawk pipe between his teeth. Neither man can make himself understood.

spans.title: The Waltz and the Storm
spans.blurb: A young man waltzes at a country ball with a girl who dances with her whole heart, until a smiling stranger wags a finger and repeats one name.

spans.title: Silk Stockings
spans.blurb: A wife shows a family friend the silk stockings she will wear tomorrow. His answers keep drifting toward a farewell she refuses to hear.
spans.spoilerNote: Hints that Doctor Rank is near death, a thread the play unfolds gradually.

spans.title: A Discrepancy in the Date
spans.blurb: A man about to lose his post at the bank calls on the wife of the man dismissing him. He has a paper, and questions about a date.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals Nora's secret loan and forged signature, the discovery that drives the entire play.

books.pairNote: Two separate confrontations from different acts with no shared text or shared payoff.
